channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Barbrey, Raper challenging Knight’s candidacy for sheriff
item.description: Wilson County sheriff candidates Brandon Barbrey and Kevin Raper are challenging fellow candidate Bobby Knight’s candidacy, arguing a brief party switch disqualifies him under North Carolina’s 90-day affiliation rule.

item.title: Adventists World Aviation flies supplies, donates plane to Jamaica
item.description: After Hurricane Melissa, Wilson-based Adventist World Aviation airlifted food, water and aid to cut-off Jamaican communities and permanently based a Cessna 206 in Jamaica for future relief and mission work.

item.title: Goodbye to a gem and an era: Willow Springs nears the end
item.description: After 110 years shaping Wilson’s golf culture, Willow Springs Country Club is being sold, closing a beloved course and reshaping the local golf scene.

item.title: New York’s ‘socialist’ mayor is selling hope — but it still looks like old statism
item.description: NYC’s new “socialist” mayor Zohran Mamdani promises warmth and unity, but his big-government agenda, critics argue, simply recycles old bipartisan statism from Giuliani to Clinton.

item.title: Man accused of assaulting deputy during chase remains at large
item.description: Elm City man accused of assaulting a Wilson County deputy during a foot chase remains at large and now faces new charges including assault with a deadly weapon and resisting an officer, authorities say.

item.title: Why my rural community needs a new local news site
item.description: Many rural counties across North Carolina have suffered a loss in the quantity and quality of community news. In Caswell County, Shannon Moretz is working to change that.

item.title: Remembering the second-most important achievement of 1776
item.description: As America marks 250 years of independence, another 1776 milestone — Adam Smith’s 'The Wealth of Nations' — gets a fresh look for its role in shaping capitalism, liberty and the rule of law.

item.title: North Carolina’s rigid, unresponsive legislative leadership is taking a toll
item.description: North Carolina is the only state without a budget as Senate leader Phil Berger, facing a MAGA primary challenge, blocks tax action, deepening crises in schools, health care and hunger.

item.title: Elections board deems Knight ineligible to run
item.description: Wilson County’s elections board voted 4-1 to disqualify sheriff candidate Bobby Knight over a disputed same-day party switch that deemed him ineligible to file for office. Knight plans to appeal the decision to the State Board of Elections.
